name: OP5 Monitor
description: Atomic automation workflows for common OP5 Monitor operations (hosts, services, host/service groups, contacts/contactgroups, timeperiods, config change lifecycle, filter queries, and external commands), wired to the OP5 Monitor:latest Integration Model.

1000.name: postcommand
1000.description: Submits a Naemon/Nagios external command by name (acknowledge, downtime, comment, enable/disable checks or notifications, forced re-check). See the op5 Monitor command reference (per-instance at /api/help/command) for the full parameter set per command.

command.description: Name of the external command to submit.

comment.description: Comment text attached to the command.

author.description: Author name attributed to the command.

sticky.description: For acknowledgements: keep the acknowledgement until the host/service fully recovers.

notify.description: Whether to send a notification for this command.

persistent.description: Whether the comment/acknowledgement survives program restarts.

fixed.description: Whether a downtime is fixed (true) or flexible (false).

duration.description: Duration in seconds, used for flexible downtimes.

trigger_id.description: Downtime ID that triggers this one, 0 for non-triggered.

downtime_id.description: ID of the downtime to remove (DEL_*_DOWNTIME commands).

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to remove (DEL_*_COMMENT commands).

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope from the OP5 Monitor adapter task (ok, url, status, headers, text, body).

1001.name: revertchanges
1001.description: Discards all pending configuration changes made via the config API (equivalent to Undo in the UI).

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope from the OP5 Monitor adapter task (ok, url, status, headers, text, body).

1002.name: listpendingchanges
1002.description: Lists configuration changes made via the config API that have not yet been saved.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope from the OP5 Monitor adapter task (ok, url, status, headers, text, body).

1003.name: savechanges
1003.description: Writes all pending configuration changes to their configuration files and reloads the monitoring core.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope from the OP5 Monitor adapter task (ok, url, status, headers, text, body).
Full HTTP response envelope from the OP5 Monitor adapter task (ok, url, status, headers, text, body).

1028.name: filterquery
1028.summary: Query hosts, services, or other objects by filter
1028.description: Retrieves live status and configuration data (hosts, services, hostgroups, servicegroups, contacts, downtimes, comments, log entries) using the list-view filter query language, e.g. "[hosts] state != 0".
